headline: Together AI reports a continual agent-driven system for optimizing AI inference
summary: Together AI Research's 10 November 2026 preprint describes Together Compiler (TKCC), a continual agent-driven system for optimizing inference deployments as models and traffic change. It combines a persistent engine that hot-reloads candidate forward passes, fast and higher-fidelity measurement tiers, and a cost model for selecting parallelism configurations. The authors report up to 2.6× higher throughput than leading open configurations on selected SemiAnalysis InferenceX model/hardware settings, within 24 hours and at most two nodes per model; they also report 252× more agent experiments than a restart-per-measurement approach. These are first-party results, not independently reproduced here, and the paper's production-fleet volume statement is likewise unverified.
